records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2021, increased $1.0 million, as compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We began to see the impacts of COVID-19 on certain customer transaction volumes in late March 2020 and continued to see changes into 2021, primarily within the Merchants and Billers segment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have also experienced atypical fluctuations in Biller volumes as a result of the change in timing of assessments and due dates for federal, state, and local taxes.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total operating expenses for the three months ended September 30, 2021, increased $4.2 million, or 1%, as compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in total liquidity is primarily attributable to positive operating cash flows of $147.9 million, partially offset by $39.4 million of payments related to stock repurchases, $33.0 million of payments to purchase property and equipment and software and distribution rights, $55.0 million of repayments on the Revolving Credit Facility, $29.2 million of repayments on the Term Loans, and $10.2 million of repayments on other debt.
